newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Lithuanian shares ease slightly in light trade.
newsitem.headline: Lithuanian shares ease slightly in light trade.

text.p: Lithuanian shares eased slightly in light trade on Monday, dealers said.
The group A index dipped 10.77 points to 2,385.93 in lackluster central market trade of 767,000 litas.
Hermis Bank was the most active listing in trade of 202,000 litas but its share price slipped to 200.00 litas from 210.00 litas.
The bank, which earlier forecast a 25 million litas net profit for 1996, was awarded a long-term senior debt rating of BB- and a local currency debt rating of LC-2 by Thomson BankWatch on Friday.
Dealers say the rating should increase investor interest in the bank, which is 76 percent foreign owned.
Market leader Vilniaus Bank remained stable at 1,260 litas in trade of 12,600 litas.
Ukio Bank fell ten percent to 20.25 litas in trade worth over 104,000 litas.
Birzai Dairy lost some ground, dropping 0.62 percent to 8.00 litas in trade of 63,880 litas.
Rokishkis Cheese was stable at 48.00 litas and 18,240 litas worth of its shares changed hands.
Dealers say that most group A shares are now a bit underpriced but investors are holding back in the hope that they fall further.
Block trades worth 34,800 litas were also made on Monday while volume on the secondary T-bill market was almost two million litas.
